pop.description: Pop music is defined by broad mainstream appeal, polished production, and catchy hooks. It prioritizes accessibility over complexity, with song structures built around memorable choruses.
pop.listen_when: commuting, social gatherings, working out, background music

lofi.description: Lo-fi hip hop blends mellow beats with ambient textures and slight audio imperfections — vinyl crackle, tape hiss. It's engineered for sustained focus and calm.
lofi.listen_when: studying, coding, late-night reading, creative work

rock.description: Rock music centers on electric guitars, a strong backbeat, and high energy. It ranges from stadium anthems to introspective ballads, but is defined by its drive and intensity.
rock.listen_when: working out, driving, high-intensity tasks, emotional release

ambient.description: Ambient music prioritizes texture and atmosphere over melody or rhythm. It creates immersive sonic environments designed to complement rather than demand attention.
ambient.listen_when: meditation, sleep, deep focus, background atmosphere

jazz.description: Jazz is built on improvisation, syncopated rhythms, and complex harmonic structures. It rewards careful listening and rewards attention with layers of musical conversation.
jazz.listen_when: reading, dinner, unwinding, background in cafes

synthwave.description: Synthwave draws on 1980s electronic aesthetics — pulsing synthesizers, driving basslines, and cinematic atmosphere. It balances energy with a sense of nostalgic cool.
synthwave.listen_when: night driving, coding, creative work, late-night sessions

indie pop.description: Indie pop combines the melodic hooks of pop with a more personal, lo-fi, or experimental sensibility. It trades polish for authenticity and broad themes for specific emotional detail.
indie pop.listen_when: commuting, casual listening, afternoon walks, creative work
